main_text.p: Occultari, abscondi, abscondere se. Ethpeh. Syr. [Syriac word] Idem, Joh.8.59.&12.36.
[Syriac words] Syr.Idem: [Syriac word] In occulto, id est, Clàm, Clanculum. Johann.7.4.
[Chaldee word] Ch. Reconditum, asservatum, res re-[Syriac word] Syr. Clanculum, Secretò, Matth.1.19. Act.16.37.
[Hebrew word] [Chaldee word], [Hebrew word] Ch.& Syr.Pulchrum,decorum, speciosum esse,Decens,dignum,conveniens esse.
[Hebrew words] Ch.& Syr. Pulcher, Decorus, Speciosus. Plur. [Hebrew word]. Fœm. [Hebrew word] Pulchra. Plur. [Hebrew word], & [Hebrew word].
[Hebrew words] Ch. Pulchritudo, & adverbialiter, Pulchrè, Benè, Rectè.
[Hebrew word] Heb. Cupivit,desideravit. Hinc Ethpahel Part. Syr. [Syriac word] Et desiderans, cupiens erat, desiderabat, Lucæ 16.21.
[Hebrew word] Rabb. Postquam, Quandoquidé, Quum, Cùm, habet semper post se 1. Sic & Genes.18.17. in Targ.Hierosolymit.

page.notes: Oriental words (Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac) are printed in their own scripts and are not reliably transcribed here; they are shown as placeholders. The "(condita." fragment sits at the right margin beside the Syriac line. The Syriac and Hebrew characters should be checked against the scan.
